name: Like Dislike, Star Ratings & Post Views for WordPress & WooCommerce
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
Like Dislike, Star Ratings & Post Views for WordPress & WooCommerce is a lightweight, user-friendly plugin that lets users express feedback on posts, comments, and WooCommerce products with Like, Dislike, Star Rating, and Post View Tracking.

Built with performance in mind, the plugin uses AJAX for seamless interaction and offers customization for labels, icon colors, display positions, view counters, and more.

⚠️ Note: The product star rating system in this plugin is a custom-built functionality using its own database table, not the default WooCommerce or WordPress rating/comments meta. This ensures better performance and independent control over ratings.

🎯 Key Features

👍 Like / 👎 Dislike Buttons

  • Display interactive Like and Dislike buttons for posts, comments, and products.
  • NEW: Choose how counts are displayed – as numbers or percentages.
  • Customize label texts and icon colors.
  • Optionally show or hide counts for Likes and Dislikes.
  • Dynamic option to choose which post types display Like/Dislike.
  • Restrict voting to logged-in users only (optional).

⭐ Star Ratings System

  • Display 1–5 star rating on posts and WooCommerce products.
  • Custom product rating system using a separate database table.
  • Option to hide star ratings on post detail pages.
  • Show average rating instantly with AJAX.
  • Option to allow only logged-in users to submit ratings.

👁️ Post View / Read Tracking

  • NEW: Enable post view/read counter with anti-spam options.
  • NEW: Prevent multiple counts from the same IP.
  • NEW: Configure how much content (%) must be read before counting.
  • NEW: Configure how much time (seconds) must be spent before counting.
  • NEW: Choose how to display views – as icons or text.
  • Meta box inside post/product edit screen shows:
    • Likes
    • Dislikes
    • Views
    • Ratings

⚡ AJAX-Powered Interaction

  • All actions (like/dislike/star/view) run smoothly without page reload.
  • Real-time updates for user feedback.

🛡️ Anti-Spam & Access Control

  • Restrict multiple votes/views via IP, cookies, or user login.
  • Allow or disallow guest voting.
  • Option to allow only logged-in users for Like/Dislike votes and ratings.

🎨 Highly Customizable

  • Set custom label text before Like/Dislike buttons for posts and comments separately.
  • Icon Color controls for Like and Dislike buttons.
  • Choose display type for counters (Number or Percentage).
  • View counter display as Icon or Text.
  • Position controls: before/after content or buttons.
  • Fully responsive and theme-compatible.

💬 Comments Reactions

  • Enable comment Like/Dislike voting.
  • Custom label for comment buttons (e.g., “Was this comment helpful?”).
  • Restrict to logged-in users or allow guests.

🧰 Developer-Friendly

  • Clean, lightweight code.
  • Includes hooks and filters for developers.
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for Like Dislike, Star Ratings & Post Views for WordPress & WooCommerce.
  4. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  5. Configure settings under Settings > Like Dislike Posts/Products.
sections.faq:
❓ Is the product rating feature using default WooCommerce ratings?

No. The product star rating system in this plugin is a custom-built functionality with its own dedicated database table. It does not use WooCommerce default review/comments meta.

❓ Can guests vote?

Yes, guest voting is supported using IP or cookie tracking. You can also restrict voting to logged-in users only.

❓ Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes! Works seamlessly on product pages and shop archives.

❓ Can I choose where the buttons appear?

Yes, you can choose to show buttons before or after content or product buttons. Comment voting can also be toggled.

❓ Can I customize icon styles and colors?

Yes. You can select individual colors for Like/Dislike icons, change label text, and even switch counters to percentages.

❓ Can I track post views?

Yes! You can enable view/read tracking with customizable conditions (minimum time, minimum content read). You can also prevent multiple counts from the same IP.

❓ Is it mobile responsive?

Yes, the plugin is 100% responsive and works well on all devices.
